title: Jack's plea for Americans to take jazz seriously at home
summary: Jack says foreign admiration is somewhat erroneous, and urges Americans to value jazz over rock and roll before the old timers are gone.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future
